title: Key provenance ledger and residency-aware rotation reporting
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Goal: Build an auditable 'key provenance ledger' and automated reporting pipeline that ties key lifecycle events (create/rotate/destroy) to data-residency policies and retention settings. Deliverables: 1) a signed, append-only ledger of key events (integrated with HSM/KMS audit hooks); 2) residency-aware key selection metadata surfaced in logs and the Console; 3) automated evidence bundles that can be exported per-customer and per-region for compliance reviews. This work reduces audit time for SOC2/GDPR by providing deterministic artifacts that prove which keys were used for which datasets and when rotations occurred.
acceptance_criteria: Ledger records every key lifecycle event with timestamp, actor, region, and key version id
Ledger entries are signed (HSM attestation or KMS Sign) and immutable in storage (WORM or object-versioning policy)
Rotation reports show pre/post key mappings for any active encryption boundary and are queryable by customer_id and region
Automated evidence bundles can be generated for a date range and include signed ledger slices, rotation proofs, and execution logs
Console exposes residency flag for keys and surfaces warnings when a key's residency conflicts with an asset's configured retention/residency
Integrations: support for AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, and SoftHSM (for private on-prem deployments)
tasks: Spec: key provenance ledger schema and storage model (Confluence) - https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/Key+Provenance+Ledger+Spec
Integrate KMS/HSM event hooks and normalize audit events (ENG: api endpoints + worker)
Implement signing shim: use KMS Sign API for cloud KMS; PKCS#11 sign via HSM agent for on-prem
Persist ledger slices to immutable bucket with versioning and lifecycle policy
Add residency metadata to key objects and annotate active key assignments to datasets
Build rotation-report generator job and API to produce per-customer evidence bundles
Console: add Key Residency column and rotation timeline view
End-to-end tests and a verification harness that replays events and verifies signatures
Docs: runbook for Security/Compliance to request/verify evidence bundles
comments: 2026-02-20 - Asha Mehta: Kickoff. Draft spec uploaded to Confluence. Raised question about whether to use object lock (S3 WORM) vs. append-only DB. Proposed S3 with object lock for hosted, and write-once bucket + ledger index for private.

2026-02-24 - Diego Alvarez: Implementing KMS normalization layer first. Plan: subscribe to KMS audit logs (CloudTrail / Audit Logs) and also instrument our key-management API for on-the-fly events. Will add HSM PKCS#11 shims for on-prem.

2026-02-28 - Security Review (Lauren Cho): Need to capture actor identity resolution for rotations done by automation (service accounts) vs. human operators; include nonce in signed entries to prevent replay ambiguity. Also suggested adding a signed Merkle root per day to expedite verification for auditors.

2026-03-03 - Engineering review (Francis Ng): Trade-off: Full append-only DB (Cassandra) would simplify queries but increases ops surface for compliance team. Decided to avoid a new DB; use S3/object-locked ledger slices plus an index in existing metadata DB for fast lookups.
2026-03-06 - PM feedback (Sofia Patel): Add residency-aware warnings in Console for dataset-key mismatches and an opt-in nightly report for customers with compliance contracts.

2026-03-09 - Diego Alvarez: Prototype PR open (see attachment). Prototype signs ledger entries with ephemeral KMS key and uploads slices. Found edge case where cross-region replica writes can produce out-of-order events; plan to sequence events with vector timestamp per region.

2026-03-10 - Asha Mehta: Security approval checklist largely green. Follow-ups: (1) formal pen-test of signing shim, (2) define retention policy for evidence bundles (default 7 years for enterprise customers), (3) coordinate with Console team for rollout toggles and feature flags.
review_feedback: Lauren Cho (Security): Require HSM attestation for on-prem bundles and include OS-level audit logs when requested by customer
Francis Ng (Infra): Prefer S3 object-lock for hosted; ensure lifecycle rules don't delete ledger slices prematurely—pin by release and compliance tag
Sofia Patel (PM): Make evidence bundles customer-scoped and include human-readable summary with cryptographic proofs for auditors

Add nightly evidence exporter to compliance jobs and expose an API for on-demand bundle creation
Implement Merkle root per-day publication to reduce auditor verification costs
